comment: Pack format (docs/state-objects.md "Packs"). records: merge.json's expected records (case i as obj-<i+1>, the last as obj-169, which shares obj-2's bucket). expected: written by the Odin engine (RECORD_VECTORS_WRITE=1, core/pack_test.odin); encrypted: written by the harness (RECORD_VECTORS_WRITE=1 bun test src/pack.test.ts). deflate: compressor inputs (text | repeat x times | lcg: x = x * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407 mod 2^64, byte = (x >> 33) % alphabet). frames: a plaintext range [offset, offset + length) of a pack plaintext of `total` bytes -> the Blossom frames and cipher byte range covering it.

input.text: hello hello hello hello, said the record to the pack
